title: pm-dispatch docs: lanes/spec.md says a narrowing does NOT trip clause ②, while a PR body cites objectui#8285 as saying it does
body:
Two written rules disagree about whether a **narrowing** of the spec surface declares `Clause-②: yes`, and a PR body has already been written citing the wrong one as authority.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-13T08:24Z, out of the at-tier post-hoc review of PR #17498. ⛔ No `domain:*` or `priority:*` applied. ⛔ Docs-only: no PR is wrong because of this, and PR #17498's declaration was correct either way.

## The disagreement

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md:19`, verbatim: 「放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡，不论多小，即条款②；**收窄仍是语义面，⛔ 不触条款②**。」 ⇒ a narrowing does **not** trip clause ②.
- PR #17498's body cites **objectui#8285 precedent** as saying a spec narrowing **does** declare `yes`. That is a per-card director ruling (batch #91), not rulebook text — but nothing in the PR body says so, and a later author reading that body will take it as the rule.

Both can be true at once, because they answer different questions: the rulebook says what **trips** clause ② mechanically; the ruling said what that **one card** should declare. The rulebook also already sanctions a conservative `yes` — `references/contract-review.md:9` 「claim 拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」 — so a narrowing declaring `yes` is never an error. What is missing is anywhere saying so, which is why a PR body ended up citing a precedent instead.

## Why it is worth a line rather than nothing

The cost is not a wrong declaration — conservative `yes` is cheap and the spec lane requires the at-tier review for semantic-surface cards regardless. The cost is that the **next** author reads a PR body, infers a rule that the rulebook contradicts, and either argues with a reviewer about which text wins or quietly stops declaring on narrowings because the rulebook says they do not trip. One sentence closes it.

## Proposed edit (one line, `references/lanes/spec.md` near `:19`)

> 收窄不**触发**条款②，但按 `yes` 申报恒不是错误：契约复审档复核对语义面的卡照跑（`core-rules.md:113`），「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」（`contract-review.md:9`）同样适用于收窄。⛔ 个案裁决（如 objectui#8285）不改本行。
